_comment: Fixtures that nothing in CI compiles or runs: every recipe naming them is itself
unreachable. A ratchet, not an exemption -- a new one fails the check, and so does
an entry here that has since become exercised, so the list can only shrink.
These correspond to MIR features not yet in compiler/MIR_AST_TO_C_RETIREMENT_MANIFEST.md,
so they are staged alongside the guards that run them, not forgotten. See issue #92.
Do NOT compute this as 'referenced only from justfile' -- that reports 51 and is wrong.
Resolve each reference to its recipe and check that recipe's reachability.
